coordinateContract.horizontal: signed integer chunk coordinates plus local half-metre cells
coordinateContract.vertical: signed chunked coordinates, no fixed world height
coordinateContract.serialization: decimal strings for chunk coordinates; fixed-width local integers
coordinateContract.hash: SHA-256 UTF-8 JSON array [seed, generatorVersion, namespace, decimalChunkX, decimalChunkY, decimalChunkZ, candidateIndex] first 53 bits unsigned big-endian / 2^53; exact [0,1) double

baseEnvironmentSelection.noise: smooth lattice value noise; independent named seed; scales 1024m climate / 512m geology / 256m height / 32m detail
baseEnvironmentSelection.seaMask: smooth continental noise at wavelength4096m below0.22; inland sea boundary gives coast distance; spawn island repaired to mainland route
baseEnvironmentSelection.heightGenerationOrder: continental mask and raw elevation first; classify environment; remap elevation using profile and blend; enforce drainage last
baseEnvironmentSelection.rawElevationFormula: -16 + 112*N(height,256m) + 16*N(detail,32m); continental sea mask overrides below sea before biome classification
baseEnvironmentSelection.profileHeightFormula: for each selected neighbouring biome: h=min+(max-min)*(0.7*N(height,256)+0.2*N(detail,32)+0.1*N(micro,8)); smoothstep blend at32m boundary then apply pattern and final drainage; clamp to profile range before drainage

bypass.validateArea: patch AABB expanded128m; connect opposite low-risk perimeter gates via two vertex-disjoint paths; 512m macro-region boundary low-risk portals must stay connected
bypass.failurePolicy: reject candidate; deterministic retries8; then skip patch, never block bypass to meet quota
bypass.cardinalGuarantee: For each tier and cardinal direction propose one seed-jittered anchor outside minimum radius. Search next 32 radial bands of512m until valid; generation validation fails if no anchor exists. No unsafe forced placement.

placement.crossBoundaryOwnership: candidate anchor region owns placement; adjacent regions query deterministic candidates in radius2 regions; lexicographic candidate priority resolves overlap

population.excessCatchup: bounded aggregate resource-limited update; retain timestamp and population, never reset to cap
population.overlayAllocation: overlay total floor(host totalCap*0.4); weights5:1:4 largest remainders then cap grazer2/predator1/small2; host uses remainder; combined predator cap2
population.spawnRule: Create only initial seed population or persisted births; cap is not automatic replenish. Creation needs habitat, food and species reproduction predicates. Realization is visual activation of existing individual only.

terrainStorage.coarsePolicy: homogeneous 1m cell may be packed; gameplay sees 8 identical .5m cells
terrainStorage.depthBelowSurface: metres below final solid surface, after river/cave carving
terrainStorage.orePattern: one seeded start per vein; 6-neighbour connected random walk, retry neighbour up to6; replace bedrock only; max attempts4x target count; stop rather than overwrite cavity
terrainStorage.treePattern: 0.5m trunk 1x1..2x2 cells; length sampled integer half-metres; ellipsoid canopy radius2m; generate whole candidate by owner chunk, clip only writes not candidate
terrainStorage.plantPattern: Poisson-disc patch centres min4m spacing; within patch density0.65 hash threshold; producer pools owned by patch, shared by plants and fauna
terrainStorage.cavePattern: one candidate per64m cell Bernoulli(p); capsule path length16..32m orientation uniform0..360; ceiling minimum3m; exclude structure reservation and bypass; cave remains host environment
terrainStorage.rangeSampling: continuous uniform for physical lengths then quantize to0.5m; integer inclusive uniform for counts; one draw per named candidate field; fixed for generatorVersion

harvestNodes.name: 산성 갈대
harvestNodes.condition: acidic_plant_patch; marsh acid-pool edge preferred, rare grove patch permitted

world.harvestRule: regrowS0 means no timer regrowth; water drains actual fluid amount(1 resource unit=1L), minerals deplete actual cells; plants require living parent and biomass; branch/stone consumed once; output quantity, action time, tools owned by progression sourceId
